data.name: Iva
data.gender_notes: Iva is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Iva is a Slavic name meaning 'life'. In some sources, it is also associated with ivory, suggesting a connection to beauty and strength. The name Iva carries the meaning “Life, Ivory” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Iva usually hope their child will grow to embody life, ivory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Iva belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Life, Ivory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iva total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
data.cultural_impact: Iva is a fairly common female name in several Eastern European countries, including Bulgaria, Czech Republic, Croatia, and Slovakia. It was also the name of an important Bulgarian Roman Catholic bishop, Iva Prosinčić, who served during the late 1800s.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Iva holds great spiritual significance for Christians, as it is derived from the Slavic word for 'life'. In the Christian faith, life is seen as a gift from God, and believers are encouraged to live in accordance with His will and love. By choosing the name Iva, parents may be expressing their hope that their child will live a vibrant and fulfilling life, guided by faith and grounded in God's love.
